text.aria-label: Title text 'Does a weather product's own beam/diffuse split help a PV model?'

g.text: Does a weather product's own beam/diffuse split help a PV model?

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Six PV sites in one 34 km box in Lincolnshire, hourly daylight rows, 2019-2026. Change in mean absolute error against the global-irradiance-only arm (%). Negative is better. Bars are 95% monthly block bootstrap intervals; a bar crossing zero has not been shown to help. Each panel has its own x scale. Reanalysis and satellite retrieval, not forecasts, so this is information content, not forecast skill. The physical model's contrasts change sign under the other stamp alignment; the tree's do not.'
text.tspan: Six PV sites in one 34 km box in Lincolnshire, hourly daylight rows, 2019-2026.
Change in mean absolute error against the global-irradiance-only arm (%).
Negative is better. Bars are 95% monthly block bootstrap intervals; a bar
crossing zero has not been shown to help. Each panel has its own x scale.
Reanalysis and satellite retrieval, not forecasts, so this is information
content, not forecast skill. The physical model's contrasts change sign
under the other stamp alignment; the tree's do not.
